verdict.rationale: Many irs.gov guidance pages (EIN, SS-4, MeF, e-file provider, IRIS, Pub 525 update, mobile-friendly forms) were retrieved and quoted verbatim. That implies the public reading surface returns server-rendered content to a keyless agent. The probes of /llms.txt and the .md path returned ordinary 404s rather than a challenge page, and the only 403 was on the authenticated /dmaf transactional form flow, which is outside the guidance surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe recording HTTP 200 with the identified UA on guidance pages, confirmation that pages render without JS, and independent corroboration that no CAPTCHA or bot challenge appears under repeated access.
